limits: Agent-authored references and translations await independent human review.

attempts.note: cached_unattempted cases keep their archived status in every denominator; they are unobserved, not measured

resources.gpu_scope: torch.mps current allocation sampled after loading and after each case; a separate measurement, never added to RSS
resources.rss_scope: maximum of the worker's own ru_maxrss after loading and after each case; single MPS worker process, not a process-group sample

timing.scope: corpus calls through the persistent MPS worker; no synthetic warm-up precedes the first case
